A black rectangle labelled "Generator" sits in the upper chest at the left of the image. A thin black line runs from the generator up to the neck under the chin, near the printed label "Stimulation Lead", and a second curved black line runs from the generator down across the chest toward the printed label "Sensing Lead". The figure has no panel letters, scale bar, arrows with arrowheads, axes or numeric values. The leads are plain curved lines without any drawn anatomy of the nerve, intercostal muscles or incisions, and the image is a generic schematic rather than a photograph or scan.
